name: [🎙️] Closing Shift
desc:
The elevator seals shut behind you. Below lies a family restaurant that closed in 1974... and the mascots never stopped working.

Find four keys and the four-digit code to call the elevator back. Ask the Puppet at the security desk for help, and watch the cameras. Someone is waiting outside.

- Solo or with up to 10 friends
- THEY CAN HEAR YOU: talk on voice chat and the animatronics listen. Say the right thing and they may let you go...
- Freddy, Bonnie, Chica, Foxy, Golden Freddy and Fredbear hunt by their own rules
- Hide in closets, crawl the vents, barricade doors (they kick them in)
- Keep your light on Foxy's face
- If you hear singing, don't leave the room
- The band still performs on the cameras
- A different night every day, daily rewards, levels and badges

Play with headphones.

!! This game is based of the amazing Fnaf VHS Series by Battington and uses his models, go follow his series, it's really awesome !!

llm.loop: descend to closed restaurant -> find four keys and the code while animatronics hunt -> hide, watch cameras, use voice to talk to animatronics -> call the elevator and escape
llm.objectives: find four keys and a four-digit code and escape via the elevator
llm.instructions: find four keys and the code, ask the Puppet for help, watch the cameras, hide, keep your light on Foxy; play with headphones
unique: animatronics listen to voice chat and respond to what you say
llm.thumbnails: Freddy animatronic portrait, dark hallways with animatronics, text 'They can hear you', 'Bring friends'
llm.complexity_notes: six animatronic AIs with own rules, voice chat detection, camera system, hiding/vents/doors; uses borrowed models
